453: 	 * Creates and returns the abstract builder class and injects it into the annotated class.

455: 	private JavacNode generateBuilderAbstractClass(SuperBuilderJob job, JCExpression superclassBuilderClass, List<JCExpression> superclassTypeParams, String classGenericName, String builderGenericName) {
456: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.parentType.getTreeMaker();
457: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.STATIC | Flags.ABSTRACT | Flags.PUBLIC);
458: 		
459: 		// Keep any type params of the annotated class.
460: 		ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter> allTypeParams = new ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter>();
461: 		allTypeParams.appendList(copyTypeParams(job.sourceNode, job.typeParams));
462: 		// Add builder-specific type params required for inheritable builders.
463: 		// 1. The return type for the build() method, named "C", which extends the annotated class.
464: 		JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.typeParams);
465: 		
466: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass)));
467: 		// 2. The return type for all setter methods, named "B", which extends this builder class.
468: 		Name builderClassName = job.toName(job.builderClassName);
469: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
470: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
471: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
472: 		JCTypeApply typeApply = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, builderClassName, false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
473: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(builderGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(typeApply)));
474: 		
475: 		JCExpression extending = null;
476: 		if (superclassBuilderClass != null) {
477: 			// If the annotated class extends another class, we want this builder to extend the builder of the superclass.
478: 			// 1. Add the type parameters of the superclass.
479: 			typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(superclassTypeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
480: 			// 2. Add the builder type params <C, B>.
481: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
482: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
483: 			extending = maker.TypeApply(superclassBuilderClass, typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
484: 		}
485: 		
486: 		JCClassDecl builder = maker.ClassDef(mods, builderClassName, allTypeParams.toList(), extending, List.<JCExpression>nil(), List.<JCTree>nil());
487: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builder, job.sourceNode);
488: 		return injectType(job.parentType, builder);
489: 	}

491: 	/**
492: 	 * Creates and returns the concrete builder implementation class and injects it into the annotated class.
493: 	 */
494: 	private JavacNode generateBuilderImplClass(SuperBuilderJob job) {
495: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
496: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.STATIC | Flags.PRIVATE | Flags.FINAL);
497: 		
498: 		// Extend the abstract builder.
499: 		JCExpression extending = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.toName(job.builderAbstractClassName), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
500: 		
501: 		// Add builder-specific type params required for inheritable builders.
502: 		// 1. The return type for the build() method (named "C" in the abstract builder), which is the annotated class.
503: 		JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.typeParams);
504: 		// 2. The return type for all setter methods (named "B" in the abstract builder), which is this builder class.
505: 		JCExpression builderImplClassExpression = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.toName(job.builderImplClassName), false, job.typeParams);
506: 		
507: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
508: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(annotatedClass);
509: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(builderImplClassExpression);
510: 		extending = maker.TypeApply(extending, typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
511: 		
512: 		JCClassDecl builder = maker.ClassDef(mods, job.toName(job.builderImplClassName), copyTypeParams(job.parentType, job.typeParams), extending, List.<JCExpression>nil(), List.<JCTree>nil());
513: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builder, job.sourceNode);
514: 		return injectType(job.parentType, builder);
515: 	}

528: 		
529: 		AccessLevel level = AccessLevel.PROTECTED;
530: 		
531: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> statements = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
532: 		
533: 		Name builderVariableName = job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME);
534: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {

536: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && bfd.singularData.getSingularizer() != null) {
537: 				bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().appendBuildCode(bfd.singularData, bfd.originalFieldNode, job.sourceNode, statements, bfd.builderFieldName, "b");

542: 			JCFieldAccess fieldInThis = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("this")), bfd.rawName);
543: 			
544: 			JCStatement assign = maker.Exec(maker.Assign(fieldInThis, rhs));
545: 			
546: 			// In case of @Builder.Default, set the value to the default if it was not set in the builder.
547: 			if (bfd.nameOfSetFlag != null) {
548: 				JCFieldAccess setField = maker.Select(maker.Ident(builderVariableName), bfd.nameOfSetFlag);
549: 				fieldInThis = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("this")), bfd.rawName);

554: 				statements.append(assign);
555: 			}
556: 			
557: 			if (hasNonNullAnnotations(bfd.originalFieldNode)) {
558: 				JCStatement nullCheck = generateNullCheck(maker, bfd.originalFieldNode, job.sourceNode);
559: 				if (nullCheck != null) statements.append(nullCheck);
560: 			}
561: 		}
562: 		
563: 		List<JCAnnotation> annsOnMethod = job.checkerFramework.generateSideEffectFree() ? List.of(maker.Annotation(genTypeRef(job.parentType, CheckerFrameworkVersion.NAME__SIDE_EFFECT_FREE), List.<JCExpression>nil())) : List.<JCAnnotation>nil();

565: 		
566: 		// Create a constructor that has just the builder as parameter.
567: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
568: 		long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, job.getContext());
569: 		// First add all generics that are present on the parent type.
570: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilderParameter = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
571: 		// Now add the <?, ?>.
572: 		JCWildcard wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
573: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
574: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
575: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
576: 		JCTypeApply paramType = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilderParameter.toList());

580: 		if (callBuilderBasedSuperConstructor) {

583: 					maker.Ident(job.toName("super")),

586: 		}
587: 		
588: 		JCMethodDecl constr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(maker.MethodDef(mods, job.toName("<init>"),
589: 			null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(),
590: 			maker.Block(0L, statements.toList()), null), job.sourceNode);
591: 		
592: 		injectMethod(job.parentType, constr);
593: 	}

659: 	/**
660: 	 * Generates a <code>$fillValuesFrom()</code> method in the abstract builder class that looks
661: 	 * like this:
662: 	 * <pre>
663: 	 * protected B $fillValuesFrom(final C instance) {
664: 	 *     super.$fillValuesFrom(instance);
665: 	 *     FoobarBuilder.$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder(instance, this);
666: 	 *     return self();

670: 	private JCMethodDecl generateFillValuesMethod(SuperBuilderJob job, boolean inherited, String builderGenericName, String classGenericName) {
671: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
672: 		List<JCAnnotation> annotations = List.nil();
673: 		if (inherited) {
674: 			JCAnnotation overrideAnnotation = maker.Annotation(genJavaLangTypeRef(job.builderType, "Override"), List.<JCExpression>nil());
675: 			annotations = List.of(overrideAnnotation);
676: 		}
677: 		JCModifiers modifiers = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PROTECTED, annotations);
678: 		Name name = job.toName(FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME);
679: 		JCExpression returnType = maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName));
680: 		
681: 		JCExpression classGenericNameExpr = maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName));
682: 		JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME), classGenericNameExpr, null);
683: 
684: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> body = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
685: 		
686: 		if (inherited) {
687: 			// Call super.
688: 			JCMethodInvocation callToSuper = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(),
689: 				maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("super")), name),
690: 				List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
691: 			body.append(maker.Exec(callToSuper));
692: 		}
693: 		
694: 		// Call the builder implemention's helper method that actually fills the values from the instance.
695: 		JCExpression ref = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
696: 		JCMethodInvocation callStaticFillValuesMethod = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(),
697: 			maker.Select(ref, job.toName(STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME)),
698: 			List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), maker.Ident(job.toName("this"))));
699: 		body.append(maker.Exec(callStaticFillValuesMethod));
700: 		
701: 		JCReturn returnStatement = maker.Return(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(job.toName(SELF_METHOD)), List.<JCExpression>nil()));
702: 		body.append(returnStatement);
703: 		JCBlock bodyBlock = maker.Block(0, body.toList());
704: 		
705: 		return maker.MethodDef(modifiers, name, returnType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), List.of(param), List.<JCExpression>nil(), bodyBlock, null);

708: 	/**
709: 	 * Generates a <code>$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder()</code> method in
710: 	 * the builder implementation class that copies all fields from the instance
711: 	 * to the builder. It looks like this:
712: 	 * 
713: 	 * <pre>
714: 	 * protected B $fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder(Foobar instance, FoobarBuilder<?, ?> b) {

716: 	 * }
717: 	 * </pre>

719: 	private JCMethodDecl generateStaticFillValuesMethod(SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
720: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
721: 		List<JCAnnotation> annotations = List.nil();
722: 		JCModifiers modifiers = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE | Flags.STATIC, annotations);
723: 		Name name = job.toName(STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME);
724: 		JCExpression returnType = maker.TypeIdent(CTC_VOID);
725: 		
726: 		// 1st parameter: "Foobar instance"
727: 		JCVariableDecl paramInstance = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME), cloneSelfType(job.parentType), null);
728: 
729: 		// 2nd parameter: "FoobarBuilder<?, ?> b" (plus generics on the annotated type)
730: 		// First add all generics that are present on the parent type.
731: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilderParameter = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
732: 		// Now add the <?, ?>.
733: 		JCWildcard wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
734: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
735: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
736: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
737: 		JCTypeApply builderType = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilderParameter.toList());
738: 		JCVariableDecl paramBuilder = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME), builderType, null);

740: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> body = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
741: 		
742: 		// Call the builder's setter methods to fill the values from the instance.
743: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
744: 			JCExpressionStatement exec = createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(bfd, job, setterPrefix);
745: 			body.append(exec);

747: 		
748: 		JCBlock bodyBlock = maker.Block(0, body.toList());

753: 	private JCExpressionStatement createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(BuilderFieldData bfd, SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
754: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
755: 		JCExpression[] tgt = new JCExpression[bfd.singularData == null ? 1 : 2];
756: 		if (bfd.obtainVia == null || !bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty()) {
757: 			for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
758: 				tgt[i] = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), bfd.obtainVia == null ? bfd.rawName : job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.field()));
759: 			}
760: 		} else {
761: 			if (bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
762: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
763: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
764: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(typeRef, job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
765: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
766: 				}
767: 			} else {
768: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
769: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
770: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>nil());
771: 				}
772: 			}
773: 		}
774: 		
775: 		JCExpression arg;
776: 		if (bfd.singularData == null) {
777: 			arg = tgt[0];
778: 		} else {
779: 			JCExpression eqNull = maker.Binary(CTC_EQUAL, tgt[0], maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
780: 			JCExpression emptyCollection = bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().getEmptyExpression(bfd.singularData.getTargetFqn(), maker, bfd.singularData, job.parentType, job.sourceNode);
781: 			arg = maker.Conditional(eqNull, emptyCollection, tgt[1]);
782: 		}
783: 		
784: 		String setterName = HandlerUtil.buildAccessorName(job.sourceNode, setterPrefix, bfd.name.toString());
785: 		JCMethodInvocation apply = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(setterName)), List.of(arg));
786: 		JCExpressionStatement exec = maker.Exec(apply);
787: 		return exec;
788: 	}
